text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break. Pushing a 
heavy cart, I followed behind Dream 
Journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...My sincere apologies. Even though this 
is work for the Overseas Expedition 
Support Committee, you are helping me 
out...
choice_data_list:
Not at all. Doing this alone would be 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, I have plans after this, so 
having you offer your help was a 
lifesaver. Now then, let us hurry and wrap 
this up.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much for your cooperation 
with the study abroad life survey.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No problem! My whole family owes you a 
debt of gratitude, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Journey put together a tour for my 
family when they came to Japan!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I often go on family trips myself. 
...I simply got a bit too carried away 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need a hand with anything 
else, just say the word! I'm always ready 
to help!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Then... the day after tomorrow. —By the 
day after tomorrow. Without fail. I shall 
check it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That helps. Improving the environment for 
study abroad and expeditions. That is our 
committee's... my, mission.
choice_data_list: It is expedition support, after all.
It is expedition support, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I, too, when first studying abroad... was 
helped. Therefore—cooperation... I will 
not withhold.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—I apologize for making you help organize 
materials too. Trainer-san... and you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! We just happened to be 
here. Besides, we're comrades who dug 
holes together!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in trouble again, please 
let me know. I'll help with treasure 
hunting or anything!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That is reassuring indeed. ...Now 
then, I would like to offer something in 
return, but...
choice_data_list: No need for anything like that.

In that case, let's talk about future 
expeditions...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Well aren't you quite the generous one.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, Nakayama-senpai! No, no, that's 
not it! I just helped out on my own!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...On your own, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You guys better watch out~ Make sure ya 
don't get hooked by live bait~.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're fine with it, fine by me. 
Catch ya later.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Good grief... as boisterous as ever.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Phew... Is that everything? —Now then.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Good work, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Meno-san. On patrol?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sir, yes, sir! Are all of you in the 
middle of some sort of operation?
choice_data_list:
We're helping out the Overseas Expedition 
Support Committee.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. No particular anomalies detected... 
However! Even in times of peace, shadows 
lurk everywhere. —Please remain vigilant 
and keep your guard up at all times!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes... truly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Phew... Is that everything? —Now then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right on schedule. ...It is about 
time I headed to the shop.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Orfe? Did you find anything 
you liked?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It has been a while since you had a suit 
tailored. Tell me whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: The cut on the right pleases us.

text_block_list.name: Tailor Staff
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then, please come over here 
for a fitting.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, could you show us a few 
fabric samples?

text_block_list.name: Tailor Owner
text_block_list.text: Certainly. Please wait just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—...By the way, that potted plant by the 
window. It is the only one with nothing 
blooming, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tailor Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, it hasn't grown yet. I happen to 
like growing them from seeds, you see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah. I see. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Tailor Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is gardening a hobby of yours as well, 
Journey-sama?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today as well, a few of them bloomed quite 
beautifully.
